items.alt: The dark timber front of the house, with a dotted noren curtain moving in the breeze as a scooter passes.

items.shot: Still water in a stone basin
items.alt: Still water in a stone basin, reflecting leaves and sky.
The front of the house from the street: a tiled roof, timber lattice and a lit room behind glass.
A tray with glass bottles on the tatami of a quiet room.
Dried grasses and flowers with baskets, standing in the light at the end of a timber hallway.
A long, narrow room under exposed timbers, with a small window at the far end.
A hand turning a small copper pot set in a hearth of hot sand.
A barred plaster window above dark timber boards on the street front.
A dim passage with a stool and a bench, looking out through glass doors to the bright street.
Old roof beams and rafters, with sunlight falling along one beam.
Light falling across an old wall above an antique cane chair.
Water running through a round, mossy stone set in raked gravel.
Moss, stones and low plants in the garden, seen beside the timber veranda.
A young fern growing from a bed of moss.
Fine bubbles moving along the surface of golden tea, seen close through glass.
Bubbles rising in a tall glass bottle of pale tea with a white stopper.
Sunlight falling through the timber lattice of a paper screen.
A dark tatami room with paper screens, its open doors framing a stone lantern in the garden.
Logs burning over embers inside an oven.
Small financiers in a paper cone beside a cup of tea.
A pale round sweet with a wooden pick on a dark plate, beside a bowl of tea.
A long, empty tatami room under a timber ceiling, with light at the far end.
Bright moss between stones, with leaves blurred in the foreground.
The first-floor room at the street front, with a bonsai on a low platform and timber walls.
A tatami room with a steep timber stair, lit from a window on one side.
